SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Slavery and Servitude is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Slavery and Servitude.
   B. Treat Slavery and Servitude as rumours only.
   C. Say Slavery and Servitude never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Slavery and Servitude with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Developments in Medium of trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
